text:
jen: Heads-up: placing the release train into QUIET MODE effective now. We saw a regression in the embeddings canary (p99 latency spike + small accuracy drift). Pausing non-critical merges and scheduled deploys until triage is done.

alex: Copy. Which streams are affected? Is this limited to embeddings or do other models show noise?

jen: Primarily embeddings pipeline (v2.3.1 runtime). Other models look stable so far but we’re routing traffic away from the canary pool.

carmen: Any customer-facing impact yet? Should CS expect incoming alerts?

ops-bot: ALERT: Canary cluster ci-canary-03 reported tokenization latency increase at 2026-03-23T14:12:09Z. Metric: embeddings.encode.p99 = 2.8s (baseline 0.9s).

raj: I’m oncall — starting triage. First up: capture canary logs, dump kv-cache stats, snapshot model config. Runbook: https://intra/redwood/runbooks/embeddings-canary.md (see section "latency-regressions").

jen: Triage checklist (short):
- isolate canary nodes from production pool
- roll traffic to warm fallback variant (v2.2.9-quant)
- collect traces (jaeger link) and perf profiles (perfkit)
- hold all non-security PRs targeting runtime until sign-off

alex: I’ve paused two in-flight PRs in the release queue. Will monitor canary metrics and stand by to roll forward if stable.

tess: If we rollback canary, is the fallback fully compatible with current route config? Any schema differences to watch for?

jen: Fallback is compatible. No schema changes. Expect slight cost increase; call it out in the rollback note.

raj: Quick findings: elevated GC pauses on nodes with kernel 5.12 + cuda 11.7 combo. Repro on one node after deploying latest runtime patch. Attaching excerpt:
```
[2026-03-23T14:11:58Z] gc: pause 2100ms
[2026-03-23T14:12:01Z] kvcache: miss spike
```

jen: Good catch. Ops, can you spin a candidate build with previous kernel (5.10) and run smoke? If stable we can either patch kernel or roll to fallback variant and update the canary image.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback-of-canary -> target ci-canary-03 by raj at 2026-03-23T14:18:40Z

sam: Product note: flagging major customers on the embeddings beta. We’ll prepare a short note if the rollback takes >30m.

jen: Agreed. Sam, draft a 2-line status update for CS: "We detected a canary latency regression for embeddings; routing to fallback and investigating. No data loss. We’ll update in 30 min."

jen: Update 14:26Z — rollback initiated. Monitoring metrics now.

ops-bot: INFO: Traffic shifted to fallback variant v2.2.9-quant at 2026-03-23T14:27:05Z. P99 returned to ~0.95s in 3 mins.

jen: Quick post-mortem plan: 1) root cause (kernel/runtime mismatch) 2) decision: patch kernel across canary OR pin runtime image 3) update release cadence note + brief freeze for non-critical merges for next 90m 4) retro doc.

alex: I’ll open a small follow-up PR to add a gating check for kernel/runtime combos in infra CI.

carmen: Thanks — let me know when CS can resume normal messaging.

jen: Will post final when we lift quiet mode. For now: QUIET MODE remains until we confirm canary stability for 30m post-rollback. No non-security deploys in the queue.

jen: FINAL UPDATE 14:49Z — metrics stable for 30m, promoting canary nodes back to rotation with patched runtime images. Lifting QUIET MODE. Resume normal release cadence but keep the kernel/runtime check in CI as a blocker for next 24h.

sam: Thanks all. I’ll send the customer note now. :thumbsup:

raj: Closing oncall; adding notes to incident log.

jen: Great work everyone. Short retro to follow tomorrow.
